convoLines.text: "Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything. That's all."
"Good. Anger's fuel. Just — point it somewhere useful."
"Anger's a fire — useful if you cook with it, deadly if you sleep next to it. I cook with mine. Most days."
"Still on whether you're angry."
"I work alone. Nothing personal. ...It's a little personal."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Piper always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
You show them Wild Ramps — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."
"I keep turning over the last thing Piper said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
"I should go. You know where to find me."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Can I just — What do you make of all this? Really."
"I mean — Bleak. Probably true. I keep looking for the part where it's not."
"I think we're an experiment someone forgot to label. And the unlabeled part is what scares me — it means nobody's coming to check the results."
"...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.
"Permit me: Still on what you make of all this."
"Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"That again?" Aria sighs. "I confessed that already. I'm not confessing it twice for dramatic effect."
"We went over this," Aria says, a little tired. "I already told you the truth about that."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"We never finished talking about what's been happening — we left it mid-thought, 4 days back. 'A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.'"
"Help me haul something back? Too much for one."
Halfway to the cache spot, Andre freezes. Fresh tracks — big. "We go back now. Quietly." You do. The wild, reminding you.
"Nobody says Piper's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
"Still on what's been happening."
"I work alone. Nothing personal. ...It's a little personal."
"Okay. We'll pick this up later."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"This was good." They mean it.
"About that question — What do you miss most? From before. ...if that helps."
"God. Yes. I dream about soup. Actual soup, with a spoon."
The ease drains out of it, a little.
"Still on what you miss most."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Piper is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"Sleep's gone strange. I taste the water before the others drink at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
"The fire feels smaller without Piper. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
"Sure. I'll be around."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
They grin when they spot you — unguarded, for once.
"You're kind. Don't let this place change that."
"Huh. I answered that once — back when the answer was simpler." "I dreamed Andres was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
"I work alone. Nothing personal. ...It's a little personal."
"That's the whole of it. Sorry."
"Sure — what's on your mind?"
"About grief — yeah, we never did get back to that."
"Anyway — I should get going."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."

d94: What Kofi kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
